D.t: Glenn Ivey leads by 86.5 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 252,867 votes; a one point swing is about 1,462 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +83.3 and D +89.3. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
